headline: Mountain Woods Gracewing
title: Mountain Woods Gracewing | Two Regions | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Mountain Woods Gracewing is a Wind and Earth form, and you find it in Beast Fang Ridge or Blitzwood. Its catch rate is twenty five percent, and breaking it or hitting it from behind each multiplies that by one point five. Flutternym evolves into Gracewing at level twenty one. Are you hunting this form? Comment below!
